question: The perimeter and area of a rectangular sheet are 40 m and 72 m², respectively. The length of the diagonal will be:
solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of the rectangular sheet = 40 m

Area of the rectangular sheet = 72 m²

**Concept used:**

If l and b be the length and breadth of a rectangle then the diagonal = sqrt{l²+ b²}

**Formula used:**

Area of rectangle = l × b

Perimeter of rectangle = 2(l + b)

And (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab

**Calculation:**

Let 'l' and 'b' be the sides of the rectangle

⇒ l × b = 72 m² 

and 2(l + b) = 40 m 

⇒ (l + b) = 20 m

Now, (l + b)² = l² + b² + 2lb

⇒ (20)² = l² + b² + 2(72)

⇒ 400 = l2 + b2 + 144

⇒ (l2 + b2) = 400 - 144 = 256

So, the diagonal of the rectangular sheet = sqrt{l²+ b²} = √256 = 16

**Hence, the required diagonal is 16 m.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__** The diagonal of the rectangular sheet = sqrt {(l +b)² -2lb} = sqrt {(20² -2times 72})

⇒ √400 - 144 = √256 = 16

**∴ The diagonal of the rectangular sheet is 16 m.**
